name: Ojou-sama Crisis Erina
original_name: お嬢様クライシス絵里奈
source:
You're the only witness to something incredible going on in a classroom after school...

Haughty, domineering, and selfish...

Catch that arrogant young lady doing all kinds of embarrassing things on camera and force her to submit!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037950.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你是放学后教室里发生的令人难以置信的事情的唯一目击者……

嚣张、霸道、自私……

抓住那个傲慢的小姐姐在镜头前做各种尴尬的事，强迫她就范！！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037950.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
